items.quote: thou art a mighty prince among us
items.claim: Abraham is acknowledged by the children of Heth as a mighty prince among them

items.quote: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead
items.claim: The children of Heth offer Abraham unrestricted choice of their burial places for his dead
